study: Contextual partially pooled stacking of market, actual tipster votes and frozen team models
status: preregister before executing the new fits; retrospective inputs and evaluation already seen in prior studies
question: Do frozen, temporally out-of-sample team-score and outcome distributions add useful information when combined with market and actual tipster directions by league and pregame disagreement?
novelty_limit: An incremental combination, not a first invention. Prior learned mixtures PR423, market offsets PR430, team states PR433 and author residuals PR453 overlap. Distinguishing test: combine PR433 frozen score-static AND outcome-static predictive vectors with actual votes and market using contextual simplex weights. No new official player facts or independent evaluation games.
sources: main experiments/dynamic-score-state-model-20261030: saved frozen 2026 predictive vectors and exact-price actual-vote targets. No historical_market_proxy target. PR453 forecast file is evaluation comparator only, never a training feature.
cohort: 445 actual-vote targets in 2026, 272 before June, 51 June validation, 122 July-October evaluation; 122 is a subset of 445, not an independent additional sample
base_forecasts: Use only mode=frozen and model=score-static/outcome-static, whose original team-state training used 2023-25 prior scores, not 2026 outcomes. Never substitute prequential or candidate selection made from test ROI. All five leagues included; K League 2 prior-validation eligibility shortage explicitly retained as a limitation.
components: 0.98 * actual vote frequency + 0.02 / class_count, an uncalibrated score distribution
model: p(y|x)=sum_k softmax([0, X theta])_k p_k(y). Global stacking: X=[1]. Contextual stacking: X=[1, onehot(league), normalized entropy(market)-0.5, normalized Jensen-Shannon(market,vote)-0.5]. L2 regularized point estimate inspired by hierarchical stacking; NOT full Bayesian posterior inference or exact paper reproduction. League coefficient penalty twice global/context penalty. No outcome-dependent input or scaling fit.
fit: Minimize mean negative log likelihood plus lambda/2 weighted coefficient squared norm, market-reference logits fixed zero. L-BFGS-B analytic gradient; deterministic zero initialization, maxiter1000 ftol1e-12 gtol1e-8. Reject fit unless finite objective and max absolute gradient <=1e-6. No ROI optimization or odds cutoff search.
time_rule: Source label_available_at = kickoff UTC +96h is an explicit hypothetical availability proxy, NOT observed receipt/official settlement. Fit base weights at June1 on earlier training rows whose proxy has passed. Choose one candidate on June validation labels whose proxy has passed July1. Tie within1e-10 prefers listed order. Refit the selected candidate and per-family validation winners on all available rows before July1. Freeze thereafter, predict all122 without updates or test selection.
comparators: original fixed 9:1 with unsmoothed actual vote vector
PR453 frozen and prequential saved probabilities on exact matching122
ablation: Report validation-chosen global and contextual family members separately even if overall selector chooses market; test performance cannot select deployment winner. Additional component baselines are descriptive, not independent hypotheses.
metrics: Flat one-unit singles at original exact stored prices, no cap in unit ROI, no change to actual monthly loss cap50000 KRW. Report hit counts, ROI, logloss, multiclass Brier, coverage, per-league counts, monthly profits, daily-close max drawdown, changed picks and learned weights. Week-cluster paired bootstrap2000 descriptive intervals vs market and fixed91. Reused retrospective data and all multiple looks invalidate fresh confirmatory claims; no promotion from an isolated positive slice.
checks: Check fixture/league/market/price/outcome equality across source archives; separate feature and label files. Flip all evaluation labels: selected weights and every prediction unchanged. Reject label fit beyond cutoff; compare analytic gradient with finite differences, simplex and finite predictions, deterministic replay, independent Decimal payout and grouped summary. Any source hash mismatch fails closed.
missing_features: executable price and independent first receipt certification
scope: Local bounded research only. Do not wake automated league workers without new evidence, alter production recommendation or wallet, deploy, restart, scale, or merge as model adoption. Draft PR with exact negative or positive result and limitations.
